    Proposition 10.1 for a basic representation-finite algebra #

    prop:fixed-integral-companion (integral-deformations.tex), for A basic and representation-finite over an algebraically closed field of characteristic two, C⁽²⁾ the all-one mesh category of Γ_A over 𝔽₂, A⁽²⁾ its projective corner and A⁽⁴⁾ = 𝒪P (tab₂): the statement Prop101Stmt (module and arrow lifts; (1) free Hom modules in every degree with E₄/2E₄ = C⁽²⁾; (2) regular lifts at projective labels; (3) the quadratic mesh presentation of E₄ with unit coefficients reducing to one) holds (fixedIntegralCompanion). The weight refinement is exists_modLiftW₂, exists_arrowLiftW₂ (PrimeWeight.lean). The instance arguments are those of the Auslander–Reiten quiver (S.hasAtMostOneArrow, S.finiteDimensional_meshHom, S.prime_fd).
